name: claude-plugin-marketplace
description: Aggregated marketplace mirroring all Claude Code plugins installed by Fabian Morf, sourced from their original repos.

plugins.name: markitdown
plugins.description: Convert PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, HTML, images, audio, EPUB, ZIP and YouTube URLs to Markdown using Microsoft's MarkItDown.

plugins.name: caveman
plugins.description: Ultra-compressed communication mode. Shortens prose while preserving technical terms, code, commands, and exact errors.

plugins.name: claude-mem
plugins.description: Memory compression system for Claude Code - persist context across sessions.

plugins.name: context-mode
plugins.description: MCP server that saves context window with sandboxed code execution, FTS5 knowledge base and session continuity.

plugins.name: security-sweep
plugins.description: Comprehensive security scanner for codebases - hardcoded secrets, injection flaws, auth issues, misconfigurations, AI-specific vulnerabilities. Covers OWASP Top 10, Mobile Top 10, and LLM Top 10.

plugins.name: obsidian
plugins.description: Claude Skills for Obsidian - wikilinks, callouts, Bases, Canvas, CLI, and vault management.

plugins.name: pyright-lsp
plugins.description: Python language server (Pyright) for type checking and code intelligence.

plugins.name: commit-commands
plugins.description: Commands for git commit workflows including commit, push, and PR creation.

plugins.name: security-guidance
plugins.description: Security review for Claude-generated code - pattern-based edit warnings, LLM-powered diff review, agentic commit reviewer.

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Automated code review for pull requests using multiple specialized agents with confidence-based scoring.

plugins.name: context7
plugins.description: Upstash Context7 MCP server for up-to-date, version-specific documentation lookup.

plugins.name: claude-md-management
plugins.description: Tools to maintain and improve CLAUDE.md files - audit quality, capture session learnings, keep project memory current.

plugins.name: frontend-design
plugins.description: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality.

plugins.name: playwright
plugins.description: Browser automation and end-to-end testing MCP server by Microsoft.
